opus_only.amal_said: دير بالك is actually the command form.
opus_only.why: The 'your' ending on بال is -ak (بالك), not -eek; Amal gave دير بالك and told him it is the command form.
Listing what is in the sky he gave a singular; Amal asked 'just one?' and he gave the plural غيوم.
One goes after the noun (or alone); he put واحدة first and Amal only kept واحدة without comment.
Wrong shape of the she-past (long -aat ending, no doubled l); Amal recast تَلَّجَت with vowels and he repeated ثلّجت.

opus_only.why: 'The wind came a lot' did not say what he meant; Amal asked 'إيش يعني؟' and steered him in English to 'it was very strong', which he then said (كان قوي كتير).
opus_only.english: the wind was very strong in the morning
